svg.title: The six orders of two strands' endpoints
svg.desc: Drawn from Lean's evaluation of CrossEdge, MisUD, MisDU and Aligned on EX02, not copied.
svg.text: E = entryPos: the entry b⁺ of the strand ending at the label (filled)
X = exitPos: the label's exit b⁻ (open); strand p dark, strand q orange, arrows entry → exit
All 20 ordered pairs of EX02, exactly one order each: crossing 7 + 7, MisUD 2, MisDU 2, aligned 1 + 1.
Lean: pair_orders (Conj43/PairOrders.lean) proves exactly one of the six for every p ≠ q; positions on the circle of 5n = 25.
